query: WITH r AS (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='postgres'), d AS (SELECT defaclacl FROM pg_default_acl,r WHERE defaclrole=r.oid AND defaclnamespace=0 AND defaclobjtype='f') SELECT current_timestamp as captured_at_utc, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d) AS postgres_global_function_override_present, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce((SELECT defaclacl FROM d),acldefault('f',r.oid))) a WHERE a.grantee=0 AND a.privilege_type='EXECUTE') AS effective_default_public_execute;
